name: @one/template-games
description: Prebuilt game runtime for the Creator Hub starter templates. One SDK7 scene bundle containing the five template starter games (tower-defense, nft-art-wall, escape-room, memory-game, castaway-2048); which game runs is selected by scene metadata (one_play.template). Built once with `npm run build` and committed as ui3/public/template-bundles/games.js (sites/public is REGENERATED from ui3/public by scripts/sync-ui3-public.mts on every dev/build, so the tracked copy must live in ui3); the Creator Hub editor serves it as the project realm's bin/index.js for template projects so the Play button runs real game logic. Dependency versions are PINNED to match bevy-explorer/project-realm-template (the realm runtime this bundle replaces).
